text:
marco: Heads-up 1pm sync: Equinox wants a Private POC. Must use customer HSM root keys and short-lived client certs. Who will own the onboarding?
irene: I'll take presales. We need a compact checklist plus recommended transfer methods to avoid security blocking the kickoff.
dmitri: Security preference: full PKCS#11 with attestation for production. For POC accept SCEP+OIDC or one-shot CSR upload. Require CA chain, HSM vendor+firmware, and attestation artifact if available.
nora: Ops note: they expect ~160 qps with bursty spikes and ~1k concurrent sessions. Ballpark -> 3-4 A100-equivalent GPUs. Pricing: offer a 30d trial with reduced reserved commit and credits; i'll draft numbers once gpu type confirmed.
marco: Irene, can you draft the exact artifacts to request and the upload options? I'll send to their infra lead.
irene: Checklist draft: 1) CA cert chain (PEM) 2) HSM vendor/model/firmware + PKCS#11 module path OR SCEP URL + OIDC client creds 3) Key policy (non-exportable, permitted ops) 4) CSR (if manual) 5) Management-plane allowlist CIDRs + jump host info 6) Bastion SSH pubkey 7) Desired cert TTL & rotation window 8) SIEM/collector endpoint for audit forwarding
dmitri: Add: PKCS#11 sign test vector (we'll issue nonce: equinox-onboard-<ts>), attestation cert/TPM quote, and any compliance evidences (SOC2/ISO). Also request their compromise/rotation playbook.
nora: Ask whether they want model pinning to Dedicated or fallback to hosted under overload. That affects capacity plan and POC cost.
marco: Recommended transport options: A) PKCS#11 over customer VPN/bastion (preferred) B) SCEP + OIDC enrollment C) encrypted upload (S3 presigned PUTs with MFA-delete or scoped SFTP). Which do we recommend for POC?
dmitri: Recommend A for production. Allow B/C for POC but mark as limited (no hardware attestation). Provide example CSR generation using PKCS#11 so they can run it locally:
```
# On customer's HSM host
pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/vendor_pkcs11.so -l --keypairgen --key-type rsa:3072 --label eqx_key
# CSR using OpenSSL pkcs11 engine
openssl req -engine pkcs11 -keyform engine -new -key "pkcs11:object=eqx_key;type=private" -out equinox.csr -subj "\/CN=equinox-client\/O=Equinox"
```
dmitri: After verification we will issue short-lived client certs (TTL 24h-7d), provide a revocation API (OCSP/CRL), and return a signed attestation token linking their HSM to the Dedicated pool.
irene: For transfer we'll offer a temporary S3 upload with pre-signed PUTs (MFA-delete enabled) or a scoped SFTP account. If they insist on objects encrypted under their KMS CMK, accept encrypted blobs and coordinate unwrap/consent.
marco: Equinox also requested audit forwarding to their Splunk instance and 60-day retention. Add that to the onboarding Qs.
nora: Operational: confirm whether Equinox permits our ephemeral CA to sign POC certs; if not, they must provide CA-signed certs which will lengthen onboarding.
infra-bot: Ticket INF-8422 created: "equinox private-poc hsm+kms onboarding & cert exchange"  assignee: irene  due: 3 business days  https://rwd.atlassian/INF-8422
dmitri: Security follow-ups I'll request from Equinox: signed ATO for POC, PKCS#11 test signature, SOC2/ISO evidence if available, and timeline for rotation windows.
marco: Timeline ask to customer: please provide chosen transfer method and artifacts within 5 business days to stay on target for a 2-week POC start. I'll send the kickoff email with checklist + sample commands.
irene: I'll draft the handoff email now and attach the checklist and CSR examples. Will update INF-8422 with their response.
marco: Thanks team. i'll post back once Equinox confirms S3 vs SFTP vs VPN and whether they permit ephemeral CA signing. :rocket:
